Як розповісти, що було колись, а тепер н: How to say what used to be true but isn’t any more (used to), what happened again and again in the past (would), what you are already used to (be used to) and what you are only getting used to (get used to).
Звички й стани в минулому, яких тепер не: Past habits and states that are no longer true: used to + V
I used to play the violin (but I don’t any more).
Те, що змінилося: there used to be: Things that have changed: there used to be
There used to be a cinema here.
Повторювані дії в минулому: would + V (т: Repeated actions in the past: would + V (actions only, not states)
Every summer Grandma would bake cherry pies.
Ти вже звик: be used to + іменник / V-in: You are already used to it: be used to + noun / V-ing
Lily is used to getting up early.
Процес звикання: get used to + іменник /: The process of getting used to something: get used to + noun / V-ing
Max is getting used to his new school.

Після did / didn’t дієслово в базовій фо: After did / didn’t the verb is in the base form, so use has no -d. In positive sentences we write used to.

У be used to і get used to слово to є пр: In be used to and get used to, the word to is a preposition, so it is followed by a noun or V-ing. Compare: I used to get up early (I did in the past) and I’m used to getting up early (it’s normal for me).
would вживаємо тільки з діями, що повтор: We use would only with actions that were repeated. For states (be, have, live, like, know) only used to works.

For present habits we don’t use used to: we say usually + Present Simple.
